screens.activity: PASS — session activity is legible and labeled non-tamperproof.
screens.limits: PASS — semantic counterexample and scope exclusions clearly presented.
screens.empty: PASS — disabled packet export and incomplete status, not false completion.

method: Each image opened and inspected individually; not inferred from screenshot generation.
